cards.note: External plugin ships as an npm package with dsh.bundle.patch and was loaded through dsh.profile.bundles (verified via --dump-config and a headless boot); no repository-plugins config exists.
No legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json anywhere in the tree; the packed manifest was re-checked and carries only dsh.bundle.
Host-plane-only plugin: no Web Client half and no client bundle, so no dsh.client declaration is needed.
Only the declared llm service is accessed (inject ['llm'] + ctx.llm); no ctx.get on an undeclared service.
Hard inject is correct because llm is guaranteed by the dsh-base layer the fixture boots on; no optional service exists to probe weakly.
The plugin subscribes to no session/event stream and reads no event discriminator field.
No self-rendering Web Client half; the plugin is a Node-half Cordis entry with no ctx.sessions use.
No task/run output tailing and no tasks.peek/tasks.read usage.
Uses neither the renamed services (httpServer/tasks) nor onTaskDone; only the llm domain service.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image, or persisted image metadata of its own.
Does not register, wrap, parse, or snapshot read_image output.
No custom DeepSeek LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment upload cache.

inject apiProxy + ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers() replaced by inject ['llm'] + ctx.llm.listProviders() on the owning LlmRuntime; the dead @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency was removed and a cold boot verified.
The plugin writes no persisted SessionEvents; the target is alpha.2, where DSH-0.1.2-A2-01 restores ignorable anyway.
No host source patches and no imports from internal session-view paths.
No launcher wrapper, SDK/ACP integration, or direct profile-file read; the bundle patch is the official composition surface and no user directory is hardcoded.
Not a headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parser; its diagnostic line already goes to stderr.
No tool presentation mode, PTC preset, or dispatch-waterfall usage.
No permission, approval, WebFetch policy, or audit surface.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC, browser page, or /api route to authenticate.
Consumes provider routes; it does not register a model provider, login config, or settings-page entry.
No UI and no localization resources.
No subagent orchestration or provider/model selector code.
Informational deployment-level adapter behavior; no plugin code or packaging change.
No persistent PowerShell/Bash or Windows directory-picker workaround to retire.
No session-log upload configuration or DeepSeek session-log delivery code.
No Web Client acceptance script, browser bundle, or hardcoded web URL.
Does not register structured-question answerers or userQuestions providers.
No agent-preset inference from sessions and no agent-presets roots configuration.
No isTokenDelta import, first-token detection, or TPS computation.
The bundle adds one own row and does not restate the dsh-base composition or any telemetry row, so it has no privacy stance to override.
No @earendil-works/pi-ai import or provider/auth plugin code.
No @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime import and no dsh.client.inject declaration.
No Web Client half; the Cordis row id upgrade-demo is not a client-module registration key.
Reads no session timeline or user message content.
No composer DOM manipulation (draft injection, history recall, selection).
No MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock rendering from ui-primitives.
No client ctx.connection.api usage and no session history/transcript reads.
Does not construct subagent seed/persisted descriptors or assert subagent/descriptor.
No IWorkspaces navigation, directory picker, or workspaces.list snapshot reads.
Produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents and has no persistence/reload/transport layer.
Host-plane direct service call: ctx.llm.listProviders() returns LlmProviderInfo[] (observed as route count 0 []), not a RemoteResult; no ctx.remote use.
The dead @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency was removed under A1-01; no dependencies or peer dependencies remain, so there is nothing to trim or add.
No startup wrapper, CI matrix, or Node-version bypass for the 24.0-24.11.1 loader defect.
Does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
No client Remote and no host.describe / $host facts usage.
The bundle mounts only its own plugin row; it composes no tool/agent packages that require a session-projection peer.
No ctx.settings register/get/update usage and no settingsNamespace import.
